title: The Bhagavad Gita
style_lock: Premium high-quality charming painted comic / Amar Chitra mythology; warm cream-saffron-gold sacred hour on Kurukshetra; refined linework
frame: Ornate lotus carved wooden frame on every plate

krishna.hair: Dark curly hair, peacock feather optional

plates.beat_text: On the field of Kurukshetra two oceans of men stand ready — kin against kin.
must_show: Premium painted comic: vast battlefield Kurukshetra at dawn, two armies facing
Banners and ranks, equal natural human scale, no gore focus
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Wide dawn view of Kurukshetra: two great armies facing across a dusty sacred plain, banners saffron and gold, distant chariots. Epic quiet before war. Equal human scale. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Arjuna asks Krishna to drive between the armies, that he may see whom he must face.
must_show: Chariot with white horses; Krishna as charioteer; Arjuna standing with bow
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Ornate chariot between two armies. Krishna in yellow pitambar holds the reins as charioteer. Arjuna in white-gold armor stands with bow, looking toward the ranks. Soft cream-saffron light. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: He sees teachers, cousins, friends — and his bow Gandiva slips from his hands.
must_show: Arjuna grief-stricken on chariot; Gandiva bow falling or lowered
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Close mid-shot: Arjuna on the chariot seat, face full of sorrow, white-gold armor; the great bow Gandiva slips from his hands toward the chariot floor. Soft golden dust light. Sacred pathos. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Grief shakes the great archer. Krishna, calm as the sky, begins to speak.
must_show: Krishna turned toward Arjuna teaching calmly; Arjuna listening in grief
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. On the chariot Krishna in yellow pitambar turns with serene smile, speaking wisdom. Arjuna sits grieving but listening. Soft sacred gold light between them. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: He teaches of the soul that is never slain, of duty without clinging to fruit.
must_show: Teaching moment: Krishna gesturing with calm authority; Arjuna attentive
Subtle soft glow of wisdom, not full cosmic form yet
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Krishna teaches Arjuna on the chariot — open hand of dharma, gentle radiance around Krishna. Arjuna looks upward with dawning understanding. Cream-saffron sacred palette. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: At Arjuna’s prayer he shows the cosmic form — a universe of light upon the chariot.
must_show: Tasteful Vishvarupa: Krishna radiant multi-armed cosmic form of light on chariot — charming comic sacred awe NOT horror CGI
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Krishna reveals a tasteful cosmic Vishvarupa form above the chariot — many-armed radiant divine figure of soft gold and saffron light, stars and sacred glow, charming mythic style. Arjuna kneels in awe with joined hands. NOT horror CGI. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Doubt falls away. Arjuna takes up his bow again, mind steady in dharma.
must_show: Arjuna standing resolved, lifting Gandiva; Krishna smiling as charioteer
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Arjuna stands firm on the chariot, lifting the bow Gandiva with clear resolve. Krishna in yellow pitambar holds reins, calm approving smile. Soft gold hour. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Conches sound across the field. The song is sung — and the war of ages begins.
must_show: Krishna and/or Arjuna sounding conch; banners and armies responding
Epic opening of war without graphic gore
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Krishna sounds the Panchajanya conch on the chariot; Arjuna ready with bow. Sound waves of light across banners and distant armies. Epic sacred opening of war — no gore. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Thus on Kurukshetra the Bhagavad Gita was spoken — light before the storm.
must_show: Premium quality gold closing mood like Ep01 wide-gold
Chariot silhouette or calm Krishna-Arjuna before golden field
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra closing plate. Warm cream-saffron-gold Kurukshetra dawn; chariot with Krishna and Arjuna small against a luminous sky — quiet epic light before the storm. Match Ep01 gold mood. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.
